name: claude-remote-notifier
description: Reliable native Windows notifications for Claude Code over VS Code Remote-SSH, using a port-free workspace event spool.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only the local test command and read-only diagnostics are available. Remote hooks and event consumption require Workspace Trust.

commands.title: Claude Remote Notifier: Set Up Current Workspace
Claude Remote Notifier: Remove From Current Workspace
Claude Remote Notifier: Test Windows Notification
Claude Remote Notifier: Test Remote Bridge
Claude Remote Notifier: Clean Event Spool

claudeRemoteNotifier.enabled.description: Consume remote Claude Code event records.

claudeRemoteNotifier.notifyWhenFocused.description: Show completion notifications even while a related VS Code window is focused. Permission, question, and failure notifications always appear.

claudeRemoteNotifier.notifyOnStop.description: Notify when the main Claude Code turn stops.

claudeRemoteNotifier.notifyOnStopFailure.description: Notify when Claude Code stops because of an API error.

claudeRemoteNotifier.notifyOnPermission.description: Notify when Claude Code needs permission.

claudeRemoteNotifier.notifyOnQuestion.description: Notify when Claude Code asks a question.

claudeRemoteNotifier.notifyOnSubagentSto.description: Install and enable SubagentStop notifications. Run Setup again after changing this setting.

claudeRemoteNotifier.pollIntervalMs.description: Fallback polling interval. File-system watchers provide the low-latency path.

claudeRemoteNotifier.maxEventAgeMs.description: Discard event records older than this duration.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:secrets && npm run build
scripts.release:build: npm run package && npm run audit:package
